title: REUNION
lines: Reunion is a data center on the moon.
It keeps 949 shots from 105 films. Every film is a tower, every shot a floor, every frame a window.
Its 2 streets are the scenes of the poem, in order: the first is “Friends embrace, laugh and share memories”.
The tallest tower is De Joodsche invalide (1939): 36 floors.
Nothing in it is older than 1914 or newer than 2020.
The sign most often read here is sheets of the past.
